title: KOMPLEMENT shoe shelf
description: KOMPLEMENT shoe shelf, white, 291/2x133/4" Two great functions in one – this slanted shelf puts your shoes on display and keeps them within easy reach whenever you need them. Just line them up and enjoy. 10-year Limited Warranty. Read about the terms in the Limited Warranty brochure.
